items.text: Init stops on load failure — a failed bootstrap fetch no longer leaves a half-loaded dashboard; the skeleton always clears and a reload toast appears.
HTTP checks on startup — /api/pages, /api/settings, /api/finders, and /api/bookmarks?all=true verify response.ok before parsing JSON.
Empty-state XSS — page names in empty states are HTML-escaped.
Inline-edit guard — renderDashboard() skips while unsaved inline edits are open; re-render no longer silently discards your changes.
Config sync without reload — cross-tab structure/settings sync shows retry toasts instead of window.location.reload() on failure.
Corrupt device settings — bad dashboardSettings JSON in localStorage falls back to server settings instead of breaking init.
Conditional all-bookmarks load — /api/bookmarks?all=true runs at startup only when global shortcuts, tag collections, or smart collections need cross-page data.
Shared visual settings — dashboard loads visual-settings.js; background presets and opacity/animation helpers are no longer duplicated in dashboard.js.
Deferred non-critical scripts — tours, onboarding, analytics, what's-new stub, and PWA hint use defer for faster first paint.
Single locale fetch — removed the duplicate loadTranslations block from dashboard.html; language.init() handles i18n.
Weather line safety — location/condition text uses textContent instead of innerHTML.
